description: Aquaculture pond classification feature parameters and thresholds. Used for rule-based classification of water bodies into aquaculture ponds, natural water, and paddy fields.

min_area_m2.description: Minimum pond area in square meters. Smaller objects are excluded as noise.

max_area_m2.description: Maximum pond area in square meters. Larger objects are likely natural lakes.

min_rectangularity.description: Minimum rectangularity (area / bounding box area). Higher values indicate more rectangular shapes typical of aquaculture ponds.

max_compactness.description: Maximum compactness (4*pi*area / perimeter^2). Circle = 1. Ponds typically moderate.

min_aspect_ratio.description: Minimum aspect ratio (max dimension / min dimension). Very low ratios indicate square shapes.

max_aspect_ratio.description: Maximum aspect ratio. Very high ratios indicate elongated shapes unlikely to be ponds.

water_freq_threshold.description: Water frequency threshold below which water bodies are considered seasonal (likely aquaculture).

texture_threshold.description: Texture score threshold for embankment detection. Higher values indicate more embankment-like texture.

adjacency_distance.description: Maximum distance (map units) to consider patches as adjacent/neighbors.

min_adjacent_ponds.description: Minimum number of adjacent ponds to classify as aquaculture cluster.

rectangularity.description: Weight for rectangularity score in final classification. Most important feature for pond identification.

compactness.description: Weight for compactness score. Moderate importance.

water_frequency.description: Weight for water frequency score. Seasonal water suggests managed ponds.

texture.description: Weight for texture score. Embankment texture indicates human construction.

adjacency.description: Weight for adjacency score. Clustered ponds indicate aquaculture areas.

aquaculture.description: Minimum total score to classify as aquaculture pond.

paddy.description: Score range for paddy field classification (between aquaculture and natural water).

natural_water.description: Maximum score for natural water classification.

feature_computation.water_frequency: fraction of time steps where pixel is water

new_pond.description: Water body present in latest period but not in baseline.

abandoned_pond.description: Water body present in baseline but not in latest period.

stable_pond.description: Water body present in both periods.

expanded_pond.description: Pond area increased significantly between periods.

shrunk_pond.description: Pond area decreased significantly between periods.

references.ndwi: McFeeters 1996 - The use of the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) in the delineation of open water features
references.mndwi: Xu 2006 - Modification of normalised difference water index (NDWI) to enhance open water features in remotely sensed imagery
references.pond_classification: Two-step approach: water extraction followed by shape/texture/adjacency classification
